Part of Nikon Coolpix series (part of series). It's the world's first compact camera to feature a built-in projector (first of its kind). So we need separate triplets.

We'll use "camera". For manufacturer: object_type "organisation" (Nikon). For series: object_type "product series". For built-in projector: maybe "feature". Now "first compact camera to feature a built-in projector": relation "first to have feature", object "built-in projector". Could also be "first with". We'll use "first to have". Qualifier maybe "point in time" of claim? Not needed.

Now subject_type for Nikon Coolpix S1000pj: "camera". object_type for compact digital camera: "camera". For Nikon: "organisation". For series: "product series". For built-in projector: "feature". For release date: object_type "date".
